label: VGLL2::CITED2

sections.text: VGLL2 encodes a transcriptional cofactor involved in skeletal-muscle differentiation.
CITED2 encodes a transcriptional cofactor that interacts with CBP/p300.

The fusion joins muscle-associated VGLL2 transcriptional cofactor sequences to another transcriptional-regulatory protein. It identifies a congenital/infantile spindle cell rhabdomyosarcoma subgroup distinct from MYOD1-mutant spindle/sclerosing rhabdomyosarcoma.
The original infantile fusion-positive cohort generally showed favorable survival, although local recurrences occurred. This observation should not be transferred to MYOD1-mutant disease.
